description: Resettable fuse or input current protection
notes: Place on USB VBUS input before board power distribution.

description: USB ESD protection for D+ and D-
notes: Use low-capacitance USB 2.0 suitable part near connector.

description: 22 or 33 ohm USB D+/D- series resistors
notes: Follow ESP32-S3 hardware guideline placement close to the MCU.

description: 10 uF input and output bulk capacitors
notes: Size and voltage rating to match selected regulator.
